1.title: High-quality education
1.description: Chinese universities are ranked in the TOP-100 worldwide and have the most modern scientific and technical base

2.title: Innovation center
2.description: The world's most advanced country in artificial intelligence, IT, robotics, and business

3.title: Affordable study costs
3.description: 2-3 times cheaper than Europe and the USA. Starting from $2000-4000 per year + scholarships
